_method: Provenance PLUS inspection, 2026-08-18. Provenance: 8 itch.io sprite packs, 7 of which name pixel art in the pack title or are pixel art by category. Provenance alone was NOT trusted -- the handoff for this session explicitly warned against labelling by folder association -- so a spread sample from EVERY pack was inspected as 28px edge-dense crops upscaled NEAREST 7x, and one pack was reclassified as a result (see _reclassified). The check that mattered: Tiny Swords is 410 of these 524 files, i.e. the label for that one pack decides the population, and it was confirmed blocky-hard by eye rather than assumed.
_what_this_population_is: 524 real game-art files. Alpha composition measured through analyze(): 198 hard-alpha (<=2 levels), 294 soft-alpha (3-4 levels), 32 opaque. It is the first pixel-art population this project has that CARRIES AN ALPHA CHANNEL -- the 31-asset labelled set is entirely opaque GIFs.
_lopsidedness_warning: Tiny Swords is 78% of this population (410/524). A pooled accuracy number over these 524 is therefore mostly a statement about ONE pack's art style. Always report per-pack as well as pooled -- populations.py's score() does.

_reclassified.free-cyberpunk-overlay-effects-for-platf: All 30 files labelled unsuitable_no_edges, NOT pixel_art and NOT antialiased. They are full-screen colour-grade overlay plates -- flat colour fields with a faint dither texture. Measured: 0.0% of horizontal steps are >=40 anywhere in the three sampled files, so the cliff measure never even runs (n=0 on 29 of 30). Labelling them antialiased would hand any hard-edge rule 30 FREE true negatives that test nothing and inflate specificity -- the falsifier-population trap in this project's own memory. They are excluded from scoring by populations.py instead.

_label_values.pixel_art: hard-edged blocky art; --pixel-art handling is correct for it
_label_values.unsuitable_no_edges: no figure/ground or no edges at all. EXCLUDED from accuracy scoring, deliberately.

_unsuitable_why.free-cyberpunk-overlay-effects-for-platf: continuous-tone full-frame colour-grade plate (1800x1200): 242-256 unique RGB, ZERO horizontal steps >=40, no figure/ground to separate. Not pixel art and not antialiased ART either -- there is nothing here to classify.
